About our brand and products:

Satiety Now is a wellness brand focused on metabolic health, appetite control, and natural balance.
Our mission is to help people achieve sustainable results through science-backed, plant-based nutrition that supports the body’s own GLP-1 pathway for appetite regulation.

Our main products include:

  • Meal Replacement Shake – A 100% plant-based, organic formula with vegan protein, fiber, and key ingredients that naturally stimulate satiety and energy.

  • GLP-1 Weight Loss Kit – A complete system designed to support appetite control, stabilize blood sugar, and promote gut health.

  • Moringa Capsules – Rich in antioxidants and nutrients that help regulate glucose and enhance fullness naturally.

  • Other functional supplements, including Berberine capsules and Gymnema tincture, are formulated to complement a balanced metabolic routine.

We believe in empowering the body through natural biological processes — not quick fixes.

What makes us different:

  • Science-Based and Natural
    We rely on clinically studied, plant-derived ingredients that activate the body’s natural appetite-control mechanisms (such as the GLP-1 hormone).

  • A Support System, Not a Substitute
    SatietyNow products are designed to support healthy metabolism and appetite, not to replace medical treatments.

  • Clean and Transparent Formulas
    Vegan, gluten-free, non-GMO, and made with premium ingredients for quality and consistency.

  • Doctor-Led Brand
    Guided by Dr. Garth Davis, a recognized bariatric surgeon, physician, and specialist in nutrition and obesity, ensuring credibility and scientific alignment.


How affiliates can earn:

  • Cookie duration: 30 days

  • Commission type: Percent of sale

Commission structure:

  1. 20% commission on first-time purchases from new customers not previously in our system.

  2. 15% commission on first-time purchases from existing customers already in our database.

  3. 10% recurring commission for returning customers who continue to use your code on repeat purchases.


How to promote us:

Anyway you like! If you think that blogging and e-mail marketing will work, go ahead! Social media? Go for it!


Other information:

  • If you have questions or need custom materials, email us at hello@satiety.com — we’re always happy to help.

  • Affiliates are encouraged to comply with local advertising (if used), health claim regulations, and avoid promoting based on false expectations. For detailed information about the science behind Satiety Now please visit https://satietynow.com/pages/the-science-behind

Welcome to Satiety Now!
Thanks for joining our Affiliate Program.

These Terms and Conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as the merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and as an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to purchase products or services from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, the affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and is bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety, you are not authorized to register as an affiliate or participate in the Program in any way.


1. Approval or Rejection of Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject any Affiliate Program registration at our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for rejecting your registration.


2. Affiliate Links and Coupons

An affiliate link is automatically generated, but you can also generate one for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and later clicks on yours, the last click (yours) will be the one that counts.

Affiliates may also be assigned a personalized coupon code. Details and usage will be clarified in your dashboard. If a customer uses both an affiliate link and a coupon code, the commission is only counted once — not doubled. If you are not assigned a branded coupon code, you are not allowed to promote any coupon.

Affiliates are allowed to promote the merchant's website on digital platforms such as Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and more, as well as through offline media like classified ads, magazines, and newspapers.


3. Commissions and Payment

You will earn a commission for every qualifying purchase made on our website through your affiliate link or coupon code. Commissions are based on the order value after discounts and do not include taxes, shipping, or other additional fees. This commission will be calculated based on the amount the customer pays after the discount.

Commission rates vary depending on the type of customer:

  • 20% first-time commission for new customers who were not previously in our database before using your coupon code.

  • 15% first-time comission for existing customers already in our system before using your coupon.

  • 10% recurrent commission for returning customers who continue to use your coupon on repeat purchases.


These rates apply only to non-subscription product purchases.

To receive your commission, you must fill out your payment details in the Settings section. Payments are made weekly and only for completed transactions. You can track your commissions in the “Commission” tab, and paid commissions will appear in the “Payment” tab. Orders that result in chargebacks or refunds will not be eligible for payment.

Please note that the Program is subject to a fair use policy that allows the merchant to review all referral orders.


4. Marketing Tools

We may provide you with promotional materials such as banners, logos, or special offers via the “Marketing Tools” tab. You can download these assets or use the HTML embed code to share them on your affiliate channels.


5. Network

If the “Network” feature is enabled, affiliates may invite others to join the program as sub-affiliates. When a sub-affiliate refers a customer who completes a purchase, the upline affiliate may receive a network commission, based on the merchant’s specific settings.

To invite others, simply share your network referral link. Anyone who signs up through that link will become your sub-affiliate.


6. Cookies

We use cookies to track users who click on your affiliate link. If a customer disables cookies or clears them, we won’t be able to track their activity and commissions will not be granted.

The cookie duration is specified in the Affiliate Registration Form. Tracking starts when a customer clicks on your affiliate link or uses your coupon. During the active cookie period, any purchase by that customer will result in a commission for you — even if they don’t click your link again.


7. Restrictions on Product Promotion and Medical Claims

Affiliates are prohibited from making exaggerated or misleading claims about the products. You may not state that any product cures diseases, treats medical conditions, or replaces professional medical advice or treatment.

Affiliates must not give medical advice under any circumstances. If a customer has questions about a product due to a health condition, they should be encouraged to consult a healthcare professional before purchasing.


8. Removal from the Referral Program

If you wish to be removed from the affiliate program, please contact us at info@satietynow.com.


Go forward and refer!
We’re thrilled to have you on board. You can revisit these Affiliate Program Terms and Conditions at any time. If you have questions, don’t hesitate to contact us at info@satietynow.com — we’re here to support you.
